content: Un'kyɔm a bɔr u Kana
Kyekà, ilä kyàtär, kàkäl anà un'kyɔm a bɔr mwɛy u Kana, u Ngalilɛ. Ngwän a Yɛsu kàkäl kwo.
Yɛsu sye bàkyer un'bel anà alɔŋki ande kà un'kyɔm awà.
Yàmɛnà naa man màkyer awà. Ngwän a Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ba vin latɛy. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Un'kaar wà, ngye anà mɛ inina? Taaŋ amɛ ŋàtàkwo anki. »
Ngwän waa kàtɛn a asyääl naa: « Làkyer yinà yanswà utɛn nde a bɛ. »
Paa màkäl anà an'buuŋ, an'buuŋ an'syaam mà nkɔŋ, amà bàfasyäälà Ayudà ntɔn mupöŋ ndür. U làbuuŋ làmwɛy man'kwo ibilà isii a an'litre an'kwem an'tär aŋitär.
Yɛsu kàswɛŋ asyääl naa: « Làyööl an'dà uboo a an'buuŋ mà. » Ba sye waa bàyööl ma tii u mɔɔl.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Apanà, làtɛɛ an'dà anà làsyen ma akà mfum a un'kyɔm. » Ba waa bun'syeen ma.
Kàkyee nde, an'dà màkäl man'bulà vin. Nde kàyöb anki naa vin alà lan'fà ken. Wɛɛ asyääl bàtɛɛ an'dà bàkyer ayöb. Apan sye nde kàbel ŋabɔr,
waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Baar banswà bàfàtapà vin aŋàbwaŋ. Ungö, isàkal naa baar ban'yɔr, waa bapà vin làkɔ̈ɔ̈n ntsà. Wɛɛ ngye, ngye vin a ntsà akyer asàlɔɔn tii apanà! »
Ayi nsɛmà a idiim a Yɛsu yàlyaaŋ u Kana a Ngalilɛ. Nde kàmɛɛy làkoo ande, alɔŋki ande waa bun'si làkwikilà.
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàtyà Kapɛrnawum anà ngwän, anà atɔŋ ande anà alɔŋki ande. Ba kwo bàkyer anki ilä mbɔɔn.
Yɛsu uboo a ndwà a Nzam
Pak a Ayudà làkäl tsütsü mukwo, Yɛsu waa kàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Nde kàmɛn ayääl a ngɔɔmà, in'kɔk, an'yem anà agyɛɛŋ a ngim sye bàkyàbwaay uboo a ndwà a Nzam.
Abun, nde kàkyer füm a in'siŋ, waa kàböŋ ba banswà u ndwà a Nzam, anà ngɔɔmà, anà in'kɔk aba. Nde kàpay ngim a agyɛɛŋ anà kàbuum mɛsà aba.
Nde kàtɛn a ayääl a an'yem naa: « Làlwom indiir abi byanswà pà! Twon lan'buul ndwà a Taaràmɛ ndwà atà yà! »
Alɔŋki ande bàyɔbà naa bàsön abà: « Ukwen a ndwà angye bàkyer asan'kwiiy. »
Apan, amfum a Ayudà bun'fuul naa: « Idiim nà an'kwo ngye mukyer, ntɔn muswaŋ naa ngye awe anà ikɔ̈b mukyer abà? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Làbwaab ndwà a Nzam yi, ungö a ilä itär mɛ in'yàmbaar ya. » –
Apan, Ayudà abà bàtɛn a nde naa: « Yàlɔ̈m mbul an'kwem an'nà aŋisyaam mutɔŋ ndwà ayi, wɛɛ ngye, ngye ya ayàmbaar ungö a ilä itär? »
Wɛɛ, kyekà, ndwà a Nzam kàtɛɛnà nde yàkäl ndür ande ŋakwo.
Ungöngö, umpal kàwiyà Yɛsu uboo a akü, alɔŋki ande waa bàyɔbà naa nde kàkyàtɛn abà. Kyakin bàsi ba làkwikilà amu Ndaa Aŋàsɔn anà amu ndaa kàtɛn nde.
Yɛsu akyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ mpem a mbuur
Utaaŋ kàkäl Yɛsu u Yɛlusàlɛm, umpal a un'kyɔm a Pak, bàmbɔɔn bàsi làkwikilà kà ikɔb ande ntɔn idiim kàfakyerà nde.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu, nde ba làkwikilà kasyeelà anki, ntɔn nde kàkyayöb ba banswà ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Nde kàkäl anki anà mfun naa bun'tɛɛl imbäl ntɔn mbuur, ntɔn nde ŋakwo kàkyer ayöbà naa ininà abyu mpem a mbuur.
